# Fat black cat walking cycle

**File:** `black-cat-walk.png` (1536 × 1024, RGBA; 4 columns × 2 rows). Transparent alpha was checked before integration.

**Method:** Built-in image generation, September 28, 2026. No reference photos, video, or external cat footage were used in the final asset. The original generated file was copied into the project without image edits. CSS selects the eight frames and moves the sprite through the current scene; roll and yarn behaviors are added in code.

**Exact successful prompt:**

> Create one transparent animation sprite sheet, landscape 1536x1024, a precise 4-column by 2-row grid of EIGHT equally sized cells. Each cell contains the SAME VERY FAT BLACK CAT in a successive pose of a walking cycle, facing RIGHT. Cinematic 3D animation quality, realistic dense short charcoal-black fur, big round belly, very plump body, short thick legs, rounded cheeks, small golden amber eyes, a gently curved tail, believable feline anatomy. Not a flat cartoon, not a photograph, no scenery. Full-body side view with a subtle three-quarter view of face. Cat at identical scale and torso position in every cell. Eight successive walking poses ordered left-to-right, then second row, alternating front and rear paws and gently shifting tail; full cycle returns seamlessly to first pose. Each entire cat fits in its own equal cell with generous padding around all limbs and tail. Soft warm studio key light plus subtle rim light revealing black fur against any background. Actual transparent alpha background, absolutely no checkerboard pattern, no backdrop, no ground, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no borders, no shadows outside the cats, no accessories. This will be used as a website sprite sheet for a black plump cat walking across existing scenes.
